notes: Balance sheet indicators are closing stock for last month selected; P&L and lead flows are summed over selected months.
Office drill-down uses region chunk; liquidity is reportable by region, not by branch.
All data are synthetic and for portfolio demonstration only.
dataLineage: Original 300053-row workbook + office calibration v4 + v7 risk ECL, segment transfer pricing and commercial staff attribution overlays; web JSON are authoritative for v7.

calibration.method: Stable deterministic office factors, ratio diversity, reweighting of branch financial facts preserving 2024 region/month/segment/product totals
calibration.preservedTotals: Region-month-segment-product core, monthly region assets, previous assets, local operating costs
calibration.note: The original 300,053-row XLSX is the V3 baseline, not an updated source for V4 branch figures. Use office-overrides-v4.csv and core-offices-r*.json as authoritative V4 branch overlay.

v7.transferPricing: transfer-pricing-v7.json: funding cost reallocated monthly across segments, regional total and bank profit unchanged
v7.workforce: office-attribution-v7.json: attributed_commercial_income MEUR and allocated FTE; commercial managers unchanged
v7.ratings: Ratings table ECL is sampled and independent of core credit book
v7.reconstruction: Run recalibrate_risk_staff_v7.py on v6 JSON only; do not re-run on already recalibrated data.
